test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If the length of a cuboid is 33 cm, breadth is 4 cm and volume is 7524 cm³, then find the height (in cm) of the cuboid.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Height** = **Volume** ÷ (**Length** × **Breadth**)

Height = 7524 ÷ (33 × 4)

Height = 7524 ÷ 132 = 57 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 57 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

**Length (l)** = 33 cm

**Breadth (b)** = 4 cm

**Volume (V)** = 7524 cm³

**Formula Used:**

**Volume of a cuboid** = **l** × **b** × **h**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa2c67171c110746b8b010dd34f060596d7cc45350895cc51a395b910c81d3a9.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ 7524 = 33 × 4 × **h**

⇒ 7524 = 132 × **h**

⇒ **h** = 7524 ÷ 132

⇒ **h** = 57 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 57 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cuboid

The total surface area is calculated as 2 × (lb + bh + hl).

Diagonal of a Cuboid

The longest rod that can fit in a cuboid is given by √(l² + b² + h²).

Lateral Surface Area

Area of four walls = 2 × **height** × (**length** + **breadth**).</p
